reasoning: Shows a rectangular computer keyboard with a downward triangle underneath, the standard mobile UI icon for hiding the on-screen keyboard. In a task app it works well both for literal keyboard hardware/typing tasks and for mobile UI tasks about dismissing the virtual keyboard, though it should not be confused with a musical keyboard or numeric keypad.
